title: fix(app-shell): Installed Apps shows the engine's reason for a register-refused app
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbGpSrzUPSqJztUEqtbhr58C)_
Fixes #31651

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台的 `LocalInstallNotLoaded` 类型改成和服务端一样的两种形态（协议不兼容 `{ code, requiredRange }`、注册被拒 `{ code, message }`）；新增一个共用的原因组件 `MarketplaceNotLoadedReason`，Setup → Packages 的行和应用详情页头部都用它。注册被拒的应用现在在“未加载（代码）”后面显示引擎给的原句。
- 为什么改：#31566（PR #31650）之后服务端会给被引擎拒绝注册的安装记录带上原因原句，但控制台只认协议那一种，只显示代码，管理员看不出该卸载还是修包。
- 风险与回滚：只动控制台三个文件；协议不兼容那种的显示逐字不变（DOM 也不变），没有原句或原句为空时和以前一样只显示代码；不加语言包键。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`MarketplaceRowActions.tsx` 里新增的 `MarketplaceNotLoadedReason`（原句以文本节点渲染）；再看 `marketplaceApi.ts` 的联合类型。
- 两分钟验证：在 `ui/` 下跑 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplaceRowActions.installedAppsPins.test.tsx -t 31566`，预期新增用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`marketplaceApi.ts`**: `LocalInstallNotLoaded` is now the server's closed union (`NotLoadedMarker` in `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, PR #31650): `LocalInstallNotLoadedProtocol` `{ code: 'OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE', requiredRange }` or `LocalInstallNotLoadedRefused` `{ code, message }`. Mirrored member by member, never widened to a record.
- **`MarketplaceRowActions.tsx`**: one reader, `MarketplaceNotLoadedReason`, replaces the two copies of the reason ternary.
  - The protocol arm is told by its code, as before, and draws `marketplace.notLoaded.protocolIncompatible` in the same single span.
  - Any other code draws `marketplace.notLoaded.otherReason` with the code. When the marker carries a non-blank `message`, the engine's sentence follows it in its own block span, as a React text node, never as markup.
  - A marker with no `message`, an empty one or a blank one reads with the code alone, exactly as today. So does any other unknown shape.
- **`MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`**: the header's `notLoadedReason` closure is gone; both header placements draw `MarketplaceNotLoadedReason`.
- **Locale call (step 0): no new key.** The register-refusal arm reuses `otherReason` (which already names the code) and appends the engine's sentence as separate text, so `Clause-②: no` holds. No language pack changes. None of these names is exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`'s `.` entry, so its public surface is byte-unchanged.
- Changeset: `.changeset/31651-not-loaded-engine-reason.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch).

## Tests

New pins go into the two existing harness files as top-level `describe`s:

- `MarketplacePackagePage.notLoadedHeader-11760.test.tsx` (package page header, en and zh, catalog view and offline local view): a `{ code, message }` marker shows the badge, the code's sentence and the engine's sentence, and not "Installed · vX". A markup-shaped sentence is drawn as literal text with no element. A marker with no, empty or blank `message` reads `otherReason` alone, with no engine-sentence node.
- `MarketplaceRowActions.installedAppsPins.test.tsx` (Setup → Packages row, en and zh-Hans): the same message, markup and fallback cases on the row, plus a CONTROL: a protocol marker beside a register-refused one reads the protocol sentence exactly, with no engine sentence.
- CONTROL: the existing 11760 and 11645 pins are unedited and green, including the unknown-code case (`OS_SOME_LATER_REFUSAL` with a stray `requiredRange`), which still reads `otherReason` and never shows the range.

## Acceptance notes

- The engine's sentence is English server text and is drawn after the localized sentence in every language. Translating it would need a sentence per refusal code, which the server does not serve.
- Not changed, per the server PR's own notes: the sample-data doors (reseed, purge) refuse only a protocol-incompatible entry. On the console side neither door is offered for any `notLoaded` entry, both arms included.
